Resolves #21095

The Portal's featured Web Desktop card now shows the desktop instead of the typographic placeholder; it was the only one of the 28 featured examples without a cover.

- `apps/portal/resources/images/examples/devmode/webdesktop-14-0.jpg` is the source original: 1280 × 720, 85,712 bytes, sha256 `673ad2fb7768671cd7e1812f6a28a8f78ade30d82b5a98c2743527fae4de4c3a`.
- `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json` names it for the `webdesktop` entry.
- The Portal reads covers from `neomjs/pages`, which serves the same bytes through neomjs/pages#88.

Evidence: L3 (the local Portal in headless Chromium at 1440 × 900 and 375 × 812, with the cover routed from the local file) → L3 required (AC-2 is a rendering claim). Residual: the cover from `neomjs/pages` main without routing, Residual-Owner: #21061 (Post-Merge Validation).

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 the entry names the cover, the source original is here, pages serves the same bytes | The entry reads `"image": "devmode/webdesktop-14-0.jpg"`; the original is in this diff, and neomjs/pages#88 adds a file with the same sha256. The raw URL answering on `main` is a post-merge check. |
| AC-2 the card renders the cover; the window and its chip show above the caption at 1440 px and inside the image box at 375 px | Outside CI: the card's preview layer read `url("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neomjs/pages/main/resources_pub/website/examples/devmode/webdesktop-14-0.jpg"), linear-gradient(…)`, and the placeholder node was gone, at 800 × 546 (1440 px) and 313 × 541 (375 px). At 1440 px the launcher and Mail's window with its "Granted by view-mail to Alex Morgan" chip sit above the caption; at 375 px the image box shows the launcher, Mail window and taskbar, with the right edge cropped; the permission chip remains visible, while its small wording is not legible at this card size. |
| AC-3 the capture is recorded | The Capture table below. |
| AC-4 neomjs.com shows the cover after 14.0.0 | Post-merge. |
